d:
A controversial video from Seoni, Madhya Pradesh, allegedly shows Additional SP Deepak Mishra asking police personnel to plant cannabis in a young man's bag during questioning at a hotel. Now, hotel owner Sanjay Sanodia has spoken about why he installed a hidden camera and how the footage was recorded. He has also accused police officers of demanding monthly payments and harassing him. The Madhya Pradesh government has suspended six police personnel, including the ASP and SDOP, and ordered a detailed investigation.
